name: Douglas DC-3 / C-47 Skytrain
summary: Twin-radial airliner and WWII transport that revolutionised air travel; survivors fly as cargo haulers, warbirds and heritage airliners.

wings: Low wing with a swept leading edge and straight trailing edge
Outer panels have dihedral; rounded tips
engines: Two large radial engines in long nacelles
fuselage: Long round fuselage with a row of rectangular windows
Tailwheel gear — sits steeply nose-up; main wheels partly exposed when retracted
Large double cargo door on the rear left (C-47)
tail: Single large rounded fin with dorsal fillet

tellTales: Large taildragger airliner with two radial engines
Swept leading edge with a straight trailing edge

confusedWith.howToTell: The Beech 18 is much smaller with twin oval fins; the DC-3 has a single large fin.
The B-25 has twin tail fins, tricycle gear and a shoulder-mounted gull wing; the DC-3 is a low-wing taildragger with one fin.
The Convair has a nosewheel and sits level; the DC-3 is a taildragger that sits tail-low on the ground.
The DC-6 has four engines and a nose wheel; the DC-3 has two engines and sits on a tailwheel.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
